title: ISLA: A Coordinate-Free, Measure-Weighted Transformer for Boundary-Driven PDEs
abstract: arXiv:2611.17141v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Symmetry is a foundational principle of physics: the behavior of a PDE-governed system does not depend on the coordinate frame, unit system, or mesh used to write it down, and neither should a surrogate model. Yet today's leading neural surrogates lack these invariances and fail under simple transformations of the same problem: for models trained on PDEs of cars in one pose (i.e., translation and rotation), rotating the full PDE raises the surface-pressure error from 4% to more than 100%, and re-sampling its boundary raises it to about 30%. We introduce ISLA (Invariant Slice Attention), a slice-attention transformer for steady, boundary-driven PDEs. Because the boundary determines the interior solution, ISLA encodes the posed boundary once into learned slices and evaluates arbitrary interior points independently through a tree-accelerated learned boundary kernel. Inputs are nondimensionalized in scales computed from the boundary, sum

translated_title: ISLA：一种面向边界驱动偏微分方程的无坐标、测度加权Transformer
translated_abstract: 对称性是物理学的基本原理：由偏微分方程（PDE）支配的系统的行为不应依赖于书写它时所采用的坐标系、单位制或网格，代理模型也不应如此。然而当今主流的神经代理模型缺乏这些不变性，在同一问题的简单变换下便会失效：对于在某一姿态（即平移和旋转）下的汽车PDE上训练的模型，旋转整个PDE会使表面压力误差从4%上升到超过100%，而对其边界进行重采样则会使误差升至约30%。我们提出了ISLA（不变切片注意力，Invariant Slice Attention），一种针对稳态、边界驱动PDE的切片注意力Transformer。由于边界决定了内部解，ISLA将给定的边界一次性编码为可学习的切片，并通过树加速的可学习边界核独立地评估任意内部点。输入使用根据边界计算得到的尺度进行无量纲化……
tldr: ISLA是一种无坐标、测度加权的切片注意力Transformer，通过将PDE边界一次性编码为可学习切片并利用树加速的可学习边界核独立评估任意内部点，实现了对旋转、平移和边界重采样等变换的强不变性，显著提升了边界驱动稳态PDE神经代理模型的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: ISLA is a coordinate-free, measure-weighted slice-attention transformer that encodes the PDE boundary once into learned slices and evaluates arbitrary interior points via a tree-accelerated learned boundary kernel, achieving strong invariance to rotations, translations, and boundary re-sampling for steady boundary-driven PDE surrogates.
